data.title: 吹雪 · 夜色车窗的霓虹
data.description: 她的轿车后座，毛领外套搭在膝上，她望着窗外流动的霓虹若有所思；手机屏幕亮着姐姐的新闻，她看了一眼便按灭——不追、不看、不比较，但都知道。
data.action: 她的轿车后座，毛领外套搭在膝上，她望着窗外流动的霓虹若有所思
data.promptProse: Fubuki sits in her sedan's rear seat, a fur-collared outer coat laid across her lap above the modest emerald dress. Her phone briefly shows news about her sister before she switches it off and returns her thoughtful gaze to the window. The medium view keeps the seat back and passing city glass close around her. Flowing neon reflections cross her pearls and dark hair, then slip over the coat as the car moves onward.
